title: Two GPT-2 circuits showed different preservation after distillation
summary: On tested prompts, DistilGPT-2 retained 87.3% accuracy on a number-comparison task versus GPT-2’s 94.0%, but fell to 35.2% on an indirect-object task where GPT-2 achieved 94.8%. Activation interventions found evidence for retained early comparison components and little recovery from the tested indirect-object heads.
organization: Informatics Institute of Technology, Sri Lanka

source_review.scope: §§3–6, Tables 4–6 and the single model-pair limitation

evidence.tested: The study compared behavior, activation readouts and matched discovery/evaluation head tests across two previously characterized circuits, and reported activation patching results.
evidence.unknown: One teacher–student pair and two tasks are represented. The result does not rule out alternate indirect-object mechanisms or establish what caused differences during the original training.
evidence.ai_role: Interventions on the learned activations of two language models exposed different functional preservation across the tested circuits.
